_ordering_rationale: JBI (Intermodal) en tete, plus gros segment et coeur strategique JB Hunt. DCS (Dedicated) ensuite, segment recurrent stable. ICS, FMS, JBT en niches.

kpis.signal: Segment hero JB Hunt (~49% CA), partenariat BNSF Quantum, sensible cycle freight
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Intermodal (rail + camionnage repositionnement). Plus gros segment JB Hunt, ~49% du CA FY24. Sensible aux cycles freight US.
kpis.description_en: Intermodal segment revenue (rail + repositioning trucking). Largest JBHT segment, ~49% of FY24 revenue. Freight cycle sensitive.

kpis.signal: Segment recurrent par contrats long terme, ~28% CA, base stable de revenus
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Dedicated Contract Services. Camions + chauffeurs dedies a un client specifique sous contrat long terme. Revenus recurrents.
kpis.description_en: Dedicated Contract Services revenue. Trucks + drivers dedicated to specific customer under long-term contract. Recurring revenue.

kpis.signal: Brokerage non-asset, cycle freight defavorable, perte operationnelle persistante
kpis.description_fr: CA segment ICS (brokerage non-asset, asset-light). En contraction depuis pic 2021. Perte operationnelle 2023-2024.
kpis.description_en: ICS segment revenue (non-asset/asset-light brokerage). Contracting since 2021 peak. Operating loss 2023-2024.

kpis.signal: Last-mile delivery e-commerce + gros articles, segment profitable
kpis.description_fr: CA segment FMS, last-mile delivery via reseau national cross-dock. Profitable, croissance e-commerce gros articles.
kpis.description_en: FMS segment revenue, last-mile delivery via national cross-dock network. Profitable, large-item e-commerce growth.

kpis.signal: Plus petit segment, dry-van full-load, cyclique
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Truckload. Dry-van full-load via equipement company-owned + J.B. Hunt 360 marketplace.
kpis.description_en: Truckload segment revenue. Dry-van full-load via company-owned equipment + J.B. Hunt 360 marketplace.

kpis.signal: Marge JBI sous pression cycle freight, contributeur principal au profit groupe
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Intermodal. ~52% du resultat operationnel total FY24 ($831M). Cyclique.
kpis.description_en: Intermodal segment operating income. ~52% of total FY24 operating income ($831M). Cyclical.

kpis.signal: Volumes Intermodal repartent legerement en 2024, indicateur cle de la demande
kpis.description_fr: Nombre de chargements Intermodal sur l'annee. KPI operationnel cle du segment hero JBHT. Donne historique 2 ans (changement de presentation).
kpis.description_en: Annual Intermodal load count. Key operational KPI for JBHT hero segment. 2-yr history (presentation change).
